items.title: Inkling 2 Mini — Thinking Machines' 26.4B looped open model for local use

items.summary: OpenAI says its GPT-6.2 models now hide their reasoning far better from copycat training.

items.title: MedChemBench — OpenAI's test of AI reasoning in medicinal chemistry

items.title: RUMOR — Bloomberg: Apple is building an AI agent that runs your Mac
items.summary: An Apple job listing points to a first-party computer-use agent for the Mac, possibly by the end of next year.

items.summary: Sam Witteveen argues the most important part of Microsoft's Ignite launches is the agent harness, not the new models.

items.summary: Codex CLI switches its default model to GPT-6.2 Sol and turns on a workspace view with previews and subagent transcripts.

items.title: Stitch Loop — Google Labs agent that keeps improving shipped products
